brief:
The Israeli Knesset voted to advance a proposed state inquiry into the October 7 attacks, Al Jazeera English reported, moving forward despite Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's objections to the investigation.

The inquiry aims to examine Israel's response to and handling of the October 7 Hamas-led assault, which killed hundreds of Israelis and triggered the ongoing war in Gaza. Netanyahu has previously resisted calls for an independent probe into the events surrounding the attack.

title: Knesset advances October 7 inquiry over Netanyahu opposition
